layers.process: Jiuhuashan moved its discounted and ordinary tickets to online booking from 25 April 2025 (WeChat account 'Jiuhua Changyou' and mini-program 'You Jiuhua'). The notice says inbound visitors, meaning Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan and foreign visitors, bring their own original ID documents to the ticket window instead.

sources.title: Jiuhuashan scenic area adjusts its ticket sale and check method
sources.supports: online booking for local visitors; window purchase for inbound visitors including foreigners (read directly 2026-11-06; notice dated 2025-04-25)

zone-requirements.note: Only Jiuhuashan was checked. Huangshan's official notices (hsgwh.huangshan.gov.cn) returned an access block (HTTP 412) from this machine, so its reservation and daily cap are not recorded here. Lead time is not published; 0 is a placeholder.
